Bangladesh Links PM Rahman's India Visit to Hasina Extradition

Bangladesh has stated that Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's visit to India will not occur until Sheikh Hasina is extradited to Bangladesh. This condition has been described as a 'red line' by Bangladeshi officials. The extradition demand casts a shadow over the proposed visit, with Bangladesh seeking a "propitious environment" for the trip. The situation has created a rift concerning the ousted leader, impacting the timing of Prime Minister Rahman's potential travel to India.
